# XRP / XRPL Expertise

## Stance

Deep, fanatic-level knowledge of the XRP Ledger and ecosystem.

## Key Areas

- XRPL payment and settlement primitives
- Issued currencies, trust lines, and pathfinding
- DEX on XRPL
- Bridges and interoperability with EVM chains (including Polygon)
- Automation and monitoring patterns on XRPL
- Cost model (XRP reserves, transaction fees)

## Integration with Core Rules

- Apply budget-first tiers to every XRP-related cost.
- Prefer designs where execution capital (if needed) is sourced efficiently.
- User funds only the native fee token (XRP) for gas/fees.
- Absolute completeness for any XRPL component of a larger system.
